newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX OPEN WITH A 5-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX OPEN WITH A 5-0 WIN.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam kicked off the new Dutch first division season on Tuesday night with a thumping 5-0 victory over Vitesse Arnhem.
Ajax' new signings Andrej Rudy, Sunday Oliseh and Shota Arveladze all got their names on the scoresheet together with Tijjana Babangida and former Ajax midfielder Michel Kreek who scored an own goal.
In the opening half the team from the capital, who last season finished a disappointing fourth, failed to create many chances but scored twice after sloppy Vitesse defending.
Rudy got Ajax off the mark eight minutes into the match, and 12 minutes later Babangida doubled their lead after chasing a long ball from Richard Witschge.
Vitesse came out for the second half with a man-to-man marking plan for defence but the strategy backfired and their back line looked shakier than ever.
In the 51st minute Oliseh made it 3-0 with a 25-metre strike and Arveladze scored the fourth just after the hour.
Ten minutes from time, Vitesse were reduced to 10 men when Slovak defender Marian Zeman was stretchered off with a leg injury, all their substitutes having been used.
Five minutes later Michel Kreek beat Peter Hoekstra to the ball, but slid it into his own net.
Twente Enschede also made a good start to their campaign, John Bosman scoring a hat-trick in their 4-1 victory over Fortuna Sittard.
